# GrowMatic SA — Privacy Notice (POPIA) — TEMPLATE

> **Plain-language starting-point template, not legal advice.** Review before
> publishing. Fill in the bracketed fields. This reflects how the product is
> actually built (tenant isolation, no data sharing) — keep it honest to that.

**Last updated:** [Date]

## Who we are

GrowMatic SA ("we", "us") provides GrowMatic Recover, a tool that helps
businesses find and follow up on unresolved quotes. For questions about your
data, contact [your email].

## What information we process

To provide the service, we process business data that our customers import,
which may include:

- Quote records: customer names, quote numbers, values, dates, and status.
- The contact details of a customer's own staff who use the tool.

We do not intentionally collect special personal information. We ask customers
not to upload information they are not entitled to share.

## Why we process it

Solely to provide the service: importing quote data, identifying unresolved
quotes, showing the customer their own dashboards and reports, and helping
their team follow up. We do not use it for anything else.

## How we protect it

- Each customer's data is isolated so that one customer can never see another's.
- Data is encrypted in transit and at rest through our infrastructure providers.
- Access is limited to what is needed to run and support the service.

## Who we share it with

We do **not** sell your data or share it with third parties for their own use.
We use reputable infrastructure providers (such as our database and hosting
providers) purely to run the service on our behalf, under their own data
protection commitments.

## How long we keep it

We keep customer data for as long as the customer uses the service. After a
customer cancels, we delete their data within 30 days of request, and can
provide an export beforehand.

## Your rights under POPIA

You may ask us to access, correct, or delete personal information we hold, or
object to how we process it. Contact us at [your email] and we will respond
within a reasonable time.

## Changes

We may update this notice. Material changes will be communicated to active
customers.
